text:
zoe: Heads-up I opened a docs PR to add a tiny section on cost vs latency breakdowns in the Console dashboards. Includes a Node + Go snippet and a sample widget YAML. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 :eyes:
mike: Can you paste the Node snippet here? I'll run the examples harness.

zoe: Node snippet from PR (minimal):
```js
// attach estimated cost and latency tags for dashboard grouping
await client.traces.create({
  name: 'api.v1.complete',
  tags: { cost_bucket: 'light', latency_bucket: 'p95-300ms' },
  metrics: { est_cost_cents: 15, latency_ms: 120 }
});
```

anika: Quick note: the Go snippet used `Labels` instead of `tags` and `Metrics` vs `metrics`. We should standardize field names in examples or add a short compatibility note.

mike: Also docs-bot flagged an absolute link to internal-runbook.md in the checklist. Replace with `../runbooks/internal-runbook.md` to avoid broken links in the site build.

docs-bot: Lint: missing unit test for widget example. Please add an examples test asserting that the widget parses `trace.tags.cost_bucket` and `trace.metrics.latency_ms`.

zoe: I'll update the Go snippet to use `tags`/`metrics`, add a one-line compatibility comment, and include the tiny test. Pushing fixes now.

preview-bot: Staging preview queued (job #10456) once CI passes.

anika: After CI + preview, we can merge. No product changes, docs-only.

zoe: Thanks all — assigning review to mike + anika when the branch is green :tada:
